lines.text: Meet FrameShot: the free screen recorder and full-page screenshot tool for Chrome.
Capture. Record. Annotate. Share.
Need the whole page, not just what fits on your screen?
Click Full page. FrameShot scrolls and stitches every part into one sharp image.
Sticky headers show once, lazy images load first, and your page is restored.
Or grab just the part you need: the visible area, a selection, or one element.
Then explain it in seconds.
Highlight what matters,
box the number that counts,
add a note with an arrow,
and number every step.
Every mark stays editable.
Sharing something private? Blur it.
FrameShot tells you when blur isn't enough,
a solid box removes it from the file.
Now, record your screen.
With sound, plus your camera.
Three.
Two.
One.
Record a tab, a window, or your whole screen,
with your mic and the tab or system sound,
plus a webcam bubble you can move while you record.
Pause anytime. It saves as you go, so a crash won't lose your take.
Stop, and it's ready to play.
Turn any moment into a GIF, made right on your computer.
Pick the size and frame rate, and it's ready to share.
Make it look good enough to post, with backgrounds, padding, shadows and a browser frame.
Screenshots and recordings live in one library.
Search it, sort it into collections, and find duplicates.
It's private by design: no account, no uploads, no tracking.
Everything stays on your computer, and it works offline.
FrameShot. Capture the web. Edit every detail.
Free forever. Add it to Chrome today.
